title: Syndicate Wars: Classic Mafia Bosses in GTA 6's Leonida
description:
Could a gangster from the 1930s survive a world where everybody has a camera? We drop four crime bosses into an invented neon city and test them against phones, feeds, money and chaos. Character-select stats are OUR rating: opinions, each with a reason in the video.

Invented scenario: the year, the city's rules and every line the bosses say are our invention. The history (Capone's ledger case, dates) is sourced below. Haruto Mizuno is an invented character. The "Florida-style" gags are fully invented.

What is official about GTA VI: Rockstar's page gives the release date (Nov 19, 2026) and the setting (Vice City, state of Leonida); it gives no story year. Everything else we say about the new game is labelled as GTA V, "fans say" or our guess.
